note: Both sets cover the same core facts (50° solar altitude at fall equinox noon, 0° window azimuth, the Height = Depth*tan(solar elevation)/Cos(solar azimuth–window azimuth) and Height = D*1.2 formulas, 1:1 depth-to-height ratio, truncated isosceles triangle louver shape, 25° structural bend, powder-coated finish) with supporting quotes. Both contain redundant duplicate claims (shape, bend angle, and in B also the 1:1 ratio), but B additionally misbinds the 25° angle to the 'louver longitudinal section' as the entity rather than to the louver's bend, and repeats the ratio claim. A's only notable flaw is one bend claim with a truncated condition string ('along the louver longit'), so A is marginally cleaner and more faithful.
